# BlockBuddies Offline v1.5.89

This release completes the Shadow Oracle outfit so its jacket is visible from
every direction.

## Fixed

- Added the missing purple jacket panel across the avatar's back.
- Connected the rear jacket to both sides so turning the avatar no longer
  reveals a bare torso gap.
- Added lavender collar, centre-seam, and hem details to match the outfit's
  existing front design.

## Regression coverage

- Added geometry tests that require full rear-torso coverage.
- Added checks for both side connectors and the rear collar, seam, and hem.
- Visually verified the equipped outfit from directly behind at a phone-sized
  viewport.

## Android updates

- Uses the production package ID `com.blockbuddies.offline`.
- Retains the exact v1.5.79 update-signing identity so existing installations
  can update normally.

## Included files

- `BlockBuddies-Offline-v1.5.89.apk`
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`
- `SIGNING-CERTIFICATE.txt`
- `APK-BADGING.txt`

## Validation

- ESLint and Oxlint
- TypeScript type checking
- Full Vitest unit and component suite
- Production web build
- Capacitor Android sync and release APK assembly
- Exact v1.5.79 signer-certificate check in GitHub Actions
- Production package-name and app-label checks in GitHub Actions
